data.gender_notes: Avi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, ‘Avi’ is derived from the root ‘av’ meaning ‘breath’ or ‘life’. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is believed to sustain the universe with his breath. The name Avi carries the meaning “Breath, Life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avi usually hope their child will grow to embody breath, life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine power of life and breath.
data.etymology: Avi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breath, Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
